meta.title: Ghollak — Personal & business finance for iPhone, iPad and Mac
meta.description: Simple as a piggy bank, complete as a ledger. Accounts, people, store and invoices, checks, reports and PDF/Excel export — in English, Persian and Arabic.

hero.title_html:
Simple as a piggy bank.
Complete as a ledger.
hero.sub: Your personal money and your business in one calm app — accounts, the people who owe you, your store, checks and reports you'd be proud to send.
hero.privacy: No sign-up. Your data stays on your device.

chapters.title_html: Everything your money touches, in one place.
chapters.sub: Start with a single account. Grow into a full shop. Ghollak keeps up.

items.title: See all your money at a glance.
items.body: Accounts in any currency, a daily digest of what's coming up, savings goals that fill as you go, and recurring transactions that record themselves.
ticks: A savings goal for every account

items.title: Know exactly who owes whom.
items.body: A ledger for every person: what you gave, what came back and what's still open. Settle up in a tap and share a clean statement.

items.title: Run your shop from your pocket.
items.body: Products, stock, purchases, sales and returns, with a barcode scanner in the camera. Ghollak works out average cost, profit and what your inventory is worth.

items.title: Never miss a due date again.
items.body: Track checks you've received and issued, get a heads-up before they're due, and archive them once they clear. Set reminders for anything else, too.

items.title: Reports you'd proudly send.
items.body: Charts that show where the money goes, and PDF or Excel exports with your logo, title, colors and the columns you choose.
ticks: Pie, bar, line and trend charts
PDF and Excel with your branding
Every past export, one tap away

little.title_html: The little things that make it yours.

tiles.title: Home Screen widgets
tiles.body: Balances and what's next, without opening the app.

tiles.title: Face ID & Touch ID
tiles.body: Lock the app so your numbers stay yours.

tiles.title: Themes & dark mode
tiles.body: Gold, sky and more — in light or dark.

tiles.title: iCloud sync & backup
tiles.body: The same data on every device, plus manual backups.

tiles.title: Multi-currency
tiles.body: Record in any currency, with rates kept up to date.

tiles.title: Tags
tiles.body: Label transactions, then filter and chart by them.

tiles.title: Account folders
tiles.body: Group accounts and see each folder's balance.

tiles.title: Ghollak Buddy
tiles.body: A floating calculator, currency and date converter.

calendars.sub: Use Ghollak in English, Persian or Arabic, with the Solar Hijri, Gregorian or Lunar Hijri calendar — and switch whenever you like.
calendars.today: Today's date, live in each calendar

plans.title_html: Start free. Pay once when you're ready.
plans.sub: No subscriptions. Upgrade inside the app whenever you need more.
plans.note: One-time purchase · No subscription · Upgrade from inside the app
